review_note: Free tiers, nonprofit eligibility, and provider terms can change. Monthly automation watches official pages and prepares a human-review report; it does not publish changed claims automatically.

tools.name: Canva
tools.use: Create flyers, posters, social graphics, presentations, and simple brand materials.
tools.note: A general free plan is available; eligible nonprofits can apply for a separate nonprofit offer.
tools.nonprofit_note: Eligibility and application rules vary by organization and country.

tools.name: Adobe Express
tools.use: Build flyers, social posts, short videos, photos, and quick campaign graphics.
tools.note: A free plan is available; Adobe also publishes a nonprofit offer for qualifying organizations.
tools.nonprofit_note: Confirm current eligibility, renewal, and account requirements on the official offer page.

tools.name: GIMP
tools.use: Edit photos, resize campaign images, remove backgrounds, and prepare web or print graphics.
tools.note: Free, open-source software for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit application is required.

tools.name: Inkscape
tools.use: Create scalable logos, signs, icons, maps, and print-ready vector artwork.
tools.note: Free, open-source vector design software.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit application is required.

tools.name: Scribus
tools.use: Lay out brochures, newsletters, multipage packets, menus, and print-ready PDFs.
tools.note: Free, open-source desktop-publishing software.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit application is required.

tools.name: Google Forms
tools.use: Collect event signups, volunteer interest, intake details, surveys, and listing corrections.
tools.note: Available with a Google account; organizational features can depend on the account plan.
tools.nonprofit_note: Google for Nonprofits may provide additional Workspace options to eligible organizations.

tools.name: LibreOffice
tools.use: Write letters, build budgets and contact lists, prepare slide decks, and export PDFs.
tools.note: Free, open-source office software for common document, spreadsheet, and presentation files.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit application is required.

tools.name: Google for Nonprofits
tools.use: Apply for nonprofit access to selected Google products for collaboration, outreach, maps, video, and advertising support.
tools.note: Offers and availability depend on current program rules and country eligibility.
tools.nonprofit_note: Organization verification and product-specific eligibility are required.

tools.name: HubSpot Free CRM & Email
tools.use: Track contacts, simple outreach, email activity, forms, and follow-up tasks in one system.
tools.note: Free tools are available with feature and usage limits; check current terms before importing a large list.
tools.nonprofit_note: The free plan does not require nonprofit status.

tools.name: Mailchimp
tools.use: Build a small mailing list, create signup forms, and send basic newsletters or announcements.
tools.note: A free marketing plan is available with current contact, send, and feature limits.
tools.nonprofit_note: Check the provider's current nonprofit pricing separately if the free plan is too limited.

tools.name: Brevo
tools.use: Send email campaigns, organize contacts, and build simple signup or outreach workflows.
tools.note: A free plan is available with current sending and feature limits.
tools.nonprofit_note: The free plan does not require nonprofit status.

tools.name: Google Business Profile
tools.use: Manage business details, hours, photos, updates, and visibility in Google Search and Maps.
tools.note: Intended for eligible storefront and service-area businesses; follow the current profile rules.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit status is required, but the organization must meet profile eligibility rules.

tools.name: Meta Business Suite
tools.use: Schedule Facebook and Instagram posts, reply to messages, and review basic page activity.
tools.note: The management tools are available without buying ads; paid advertising remains optional.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit application is required for the standard management tools.

tools.name: Buffer
tools.use: Schedule a small set of social posts and coordinate publishing across selected channels.
tools.note: A free plan and a separate nonprofit discount are published; limits and eligibility can change.
tools.nonprofit_note: Confirm current documentation requirements before relying on the nonprofit discount.

tools.name: Audacity
tools.use: Record and edit interviews, oral histories, podcast clips, announcements, and simple audio spots.
tools.note: Free, open-source audio recording and editing software.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit application is required.

tools.name: OBS Studio
tools.use: Record screens, stream public programs, and combine cameras, slides, and audio for live or recorded events.
tools.note: Free, open-source recording and live-streaming software.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit application is required.

tools.name: Shotcut
tools.use: Edit short promotional videos, interviews, event recaps, and simple instructional clips.
tools.note: Free, open-source video-editing software.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit application is required.

tools.name: Openverse
tools.use: Search openly licensed and public-domain images or audio for outreach materials.
tools.note: Check the license and attribution requirements on every individual result before publishing it.
tools.nonprofit_note: No nonprofit application is required.

tools.name: TechSoup
tools.use: Find donated or discounted technology, nonprofit validation, training, and provider offers.
tools.note: The core membership path and individual provider offers have separate terms, fees, and eligibility rules.
tools.nonprofit_note: Organization validation is generally required before accessing partner offers.

tools.name: Microsoft for Nonprofits
tools.use: Review grants and discounts for selected cloud, productivity, security, and business tools.
tools.note: Available products and grant terms vary by country, product, and current program policy.
tools.nonprofit_note: Eligible organizations must complete nonprofit validation and meet product-specific rules.

tools.name: Slack for Nonprofits
tools.use: Coordinate staff, volunteers, programs, and partner conversations in shared channels.
tools.note: Slack publishes free or discounted upgrades for eligible nonprofit organizations.
tools.nonprofit_note: Validation and eligibility requirements apply; review the current offer before migrating a team.

tools.name: Zeffy
tools.use: Create nonprofit donation forms, event registration, ticketing, raffles, and fundraising campaigns.
tools.note: The provider describes its nonprofit platform as zero-fee and supported by optional donor contributions; confirm current terms.
tools.nonprofit_note: Designed for eligible nonprofit organizations; review verification and payment-processing requirements.
